message: Vector Rebel 3.2.91: BC Check spans previous and current calendar months, clearly distinguishes complete/partial/not completed/off/unknown, and sorts BC before Station 1 onward.
releaseNotes: BC Check now displays all C-shift tour columns across the previous and current month, grouped by month, including future tours as NOT DUE rather than missing. Current-day citywide roster includes explicitly confirmed OFF members; station grouping begins with Battalion Chief then Station 1, 2, 3 and onward. Native PPE completions are summarized per person and tour as ALL COMPLETED, PARTIAL, NOT COMPLETED when a post-tour complete native history supports it, OFF when confirmed, or NOT VERIFIED/UNKNOWN otherwise. Completed with a confirmed failed answer is highlighted ISSUE, and completion-only without answer verdict is distinguished from a safety PASS. Existing BC review persists working and explicit OFF selections locally. Two-month historical reads use bounded pairs of existing C-shift read-only reports and do not submit official inspections, edit CrewSense, or send emails. Beta candidate pending signed-in field acceptance.
